integrity: The proof independently classifies every unit Birkhoff--James pair by dihedral reduction and the norming-functional criterion. Both resulting one-parameter branches are evaluated exactly in Q(sqrt(5)); a common equality pair establishes sharpness for both constants. The bundled checker is supplementary and does not replace the continuum proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The constant chord-sum identity is established for the affine-regular decagonal plane only. No claim is made for all regular polygons, all Radon planes, or a complete classification of ordered extremal pairs.
title: Constant Birkhoff chord-sum on the affine-regular decagon
